name: Cook Out
disclaimer_extra: Cook Out publishes one four-page chart. The burger "style" rows are add-ons — the chart states them as the amount the style adds, which checks out exactly against its own hot dogs (a Cook Out Style Hot Dog is 383 cal against a plain 260, and the Cook Out Style row is 123). The chicken "style" rows are not consistent in the same way and are left out rather than guessed at; the chicken sandwiches are listed whole instead.
blurb: Build a Cook Out tray — char-grilled burgers and the styles that go on them, hot dogs, sides in two portions, and forty-odd fancy milkshakes.

categories.name: Make It a Style
categories.note: Cook Out's styles are alternatives, not extras — you order one.
